renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium work-strength constellation-afterglow guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair from the approved source; never add a coworker, manager, client, recipient, extra guardian, human, body clue, reflection, silhouette, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve canonical identity, relative size/colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes with exactly one large plus one small highlight in each visible eye, and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or canonical pair plus one clearly finished bounded strength result and one separate removable next marker covers 55–65% and remains readable at actual width 80px. A local diagnostic, alignment, bridge, signal or direction result may be complete, but never guarantee mastery, flawless quality, leadership rank, promotion, applause or future success. Connect the result and next marker only with loose, interrupted, nonpersonalized decorative star afterglow and keep a broad break or open exit; never form a closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign, deterministic route or actual birth chart. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, names, labels, score, number, date, clock, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart tip is allowed; no added heart or heart-shaped light/void. Keep every composition distinct in camera distance, bounded-result silhouette, next-marker placement and open negative-space shape. Follow compositionFamily, artDirection, distinctFrom and visualReviewFocus literally. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
